versions.changelog:
Initial release of project-sensei — a story-driven teaching and onboarding assistant for coding projects.

- Teaches users to build any project step-by-step, file by file, in clear, storybook language suitable for beginners and children.
- Offers two modes: Teach mode (rebuild and understand the project from scratch with deep explanations) and Run mode (guide users to set up and run existing projects with thorough diary-style documentation).
- Strictly avoids jargon without explanation; every command and concept is broken down in plain language.
- Maintains a "living journal" in chapters and lessons, ensuring anyone can follow along and understand not just how but why things work.
- Embeds empathy, patience, and clarity at every step—never assuming prior knowledge and always addressing potential points of confusion.
